title: Business Performance Report
description: A downloadable Power BI report for exploring performance through interactive filters, KPI summaries, transformed source data, and time-based DAX calculations.
problem: How can business performance be reviewed through a reusable reporting view?
approach: Created a Power BI report with Power Query transformations, DAX measures, filters and KPI summaries.
outcome: A downloadable report for inspecting the analysis and interacting with the available filters.
limitations: Portfolio work. No client results or independently measured business savings are claimed.
